title: Chummer6 Product Spine Promo
source_claim: 12 curated MagicFit-rendered refined deep-dive clips retitled around the product spine and simplified Horizon taxonomy

audio_quality_remaster.reason: regenerated with a continuous Unmixr narration master and a light premium voice master; no scene-clip TTS stitch, no tempo change, no hard low-pass repair

scene_narration.caption: The product starts with one table, not a shelf of labels.
scene_narration.narration: Chummer6 should feel like one table that keeps its memory: runners, rules, scenes, people, and consequences in reach.

scene_narration.caption: NEXUS-PAN is campaign continuity for device drift.
scene_narration.narration: NEXUS-PAN belongs in the product story. Its job is calm reconnects, visible conflicts, and a clean handoff across devices.

scene_narration.caption: ALICE belongs in the base workbench.
scene_narration.narration: ALICE is normal product help: build advice, explainable tradeoffs, role fit, survivability, legality, and cost.

scene_narration.caption: KARMA FORGE is governed rule evolution.
scene_narration.narration: KARMA FORGE is the rules-evolution expansion bet: house rules with impact preview, history, review, and rollback before the table commits.

scene_narration.caption: JACKPOINT is campaign memory.
scene_narration.narration: JACKPOINT is easier to understand as campaign memory: sourced dossiers, briefings, recaps, and player-safe handouts.

scene_narration.caption: RUNSITE is a specialized play mode.
scene_narration.narration: RUNSITE opens mission spaces before the run starts: routes, hotspots, layers, and GM-only context without becoming the whole product.

scene_narration.caption: RUNBOOK PRESS belongs to publish and share.
scene_narration.narration: RUNBOOK PRESS turns approved campaign material into structured guides, season books, and handoff-ready exports.

scene_narration.caption: TABLE PULSE is campaign operations.
scene_narration.narration: TABLE PULSE keeps pressure bounded: live heat, remote packets, opt-outs, private aftermath, and GM approval.

scene_narration.caption: BLACK LEDGER is the living-city expansion bet.
scene_narration.narration: BLACK LEDGER stays the big living-world bet. Factions move, districts heat up, and new jobs emerge from what happened.

scene_narration.caption: Newsreels turn consequences into table fuel.
scene_narration.narration: Newsroom clips turn fallout into rumor, pressure, jokes, and hooks the GM can bring back to the table.

scene_narration.caption: COMMUNITY HUB is the open-run lane.
scene_narration.narration: COMMUNITY HUB helps players find tables, pass preflight, schedule cleanly, and close the loop.

scene_narration.caption: One product spine: build, run, remember, publish.
scene_narration.narration: The cleaner promise is simple: build clearly, run reliably, remember consequences, and publish only what the table approves.
